items.markdown:
To use a derma stamp safely and effectively, `follow a vertical stamping motion rather than dragging or rolling the device` , as outlined in the [How to Use a Derma Stamp for Hair Growth Guide](https://rhutehair.com/blogs/rhute-answers/how-to-use-a-derma-stamp-for-hair-growth-rhute?srsltid=AU7gw4WneaSOYubXhmbIPGSX6mj01R65sLB9ZxM1LkTlMX2M48UYWpIk).[[1]](https://rhutehair.com/blogs/rhute-answers/how-to-use-a-derma-stamp-for-hair-growth-rhute)

### 1. Sanitize the Tool

- Soak or spray the derma stamp head with **70% to 100% isopropyl alcohol** for about 5 to 10 minutes before and after every use.
- Let the needles dry completely on a clean tissue before touching your skin or scalp. Never share your stamp with anyone else.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYg_daXxQFp/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ao6amlk3SEs&t=19)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDonxTZSVON/?hl=en)[[4]](https://www.sotrue.in/blogs/title/beginners-guide-to-using-a-derma-stamp)

### 2. Prep the Skin or Scalp

- **For the face:** Double-cleanse your skin to remove all makeup, oil, and dirt. Make sure your face is completely clean and dry.
- **For the scalp:** Wash, dry, and part your hair clearly into sections to expose the thinning areas. Avoid stamping over sweat, dandruff, or unwashed product buildup.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDonxTZSVON/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DNEBRN5vQ6-/?hl=en)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BryZSGObjZY)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYg_daXxQFp/?hl=en)

### 3. Adjust Needle Depth

- Choose a safe home-use depth: **0.25 mm to 0.5 mm** is best for beginners or general facial care.
- Depths of **0.5 mm to 0.75 mm** (or up to 1.0 mm on the scalp) are typically used for hair growth or targeted areas, while anything 1.0 mm and above carries a high risk of scarring and should be left to professionals.[[1]](https://stanartis.com/en/blogs/beauty-tips/dermastamp-cos-e-e-come-si-utilizza)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDonxTZSVON/?hl=en)[[3]](https://newyouskinandbodyspa.com/derma-stamp-dermastamping-for-skincare/)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYg_daXxQFp/?hl=en)

### 4. Stamp the Area

- Hold the tool firmly like a pen.
- Press the stamp **straight down** vertically into the skin or scalp, then lift it straight up.
- **Never drag, slide, or twist** the stamp across your skin, which causes tearing and damage.
- Stamp each spot about 3 to 5 times (or up to 10 times gently), overlapping each section by about half. Apply light, even pressure; it should feel like a mild pricking sensation, not severe pain.[[1]](https://rhutehair.com/blogs/rhute-answers/how-to-use-a-derma-stamp-for-hair-growth-rhute)[[2]](https://www.sotrue.in/blogs/title/beginners-guide-to-using-a-derma-stamp)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DNEBRN5vQ6-/?hl=en)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYg_daXxQFp/?hl=en)

### 5. Post-Treatment Care

- **Apply serums:** Immediately after stamping, apply a nourishing serum like **hyaluronic acid** , a **growth factor serum** , or a targeted **hair growth serum** to take advantage of open micro-channels. (Some protocols suggest waiting a few hours before applying active topicals).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/BBgZq7KYOw0)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DNEBRN5vQ6-/?hl=en)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDonxTZSVON/?hl=en)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BryZSGObjZY)[[5]](https://stanartis.com/en/blogs/beauty-tips/dermastamp-cos-e-e-come-si-utilizza)
- **Frequency:** Use the stamp only **1 to 2 times a week** (or every 1 to 2 weeks for 0.5 mm depths) to allow the skin and collagen time to heal.[[1]](https://newyouskinandbodyspa.com/derma-stamp-dermastamping-for-skincare/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDonxTZSVON/?hl=en)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYg_daXxQFp/?hl=en)

Are you planning to use the derma stamp **on your face (for scars/wrinkles)** or **on your scalp (for hair growth)** ? Let me know so I can share the exact needle depth and serum recommendations for your goal.
